system.description:
The healers of the Cabal's oldest seat, the Nalwood under Arikh Evergreen, and the circles that learned from it.

  • Reshapes: your healing spells.
  • Forest Vigour: reroll 1s on the healing dice of spells you cast.
    • 9th level: once per day, cast Cure Serious Wounds without expending a slot.
  • Ancient Lore: Advantage on checks to find, identify and prepare healing herbs, and to treat poison and disease.
